title: Word2Vec

paper.title: Efficient Estimation of Word Representations in Vector Space
paper.year_note: Original/preprint year except GCN (2017 venue, 2016 preprint) and speculative decoding (2023 venue, 2022 preprint).

statement: Implement Word2Vec: learn text8 skip-gram embeddings and evaluate held-out word analogies without training on evaluation pairs. Read the linked paper and isolate the named mechanism. Write a self-contained solve(data), fit using training tensors only, and return Submission(model=model). Keep validation labels out of fitting and preprocessing. This is an educational reduced-scale adaptation, not a claim to reproduce original paper results. Use text8; required output: Token IDs -> embedding vectors. Evaluate analogy_accuracy (maximize). Analogy set must not overlap model selection; negative-sampling unigram distribution is training-only. Required ablation: Compare negative sampling rates under an equal token budget. Curriculum draft: reference, task-specific objective/evaluation adaptation and thresholds remain unimplemented; a named dataset may have a loader but this does not make this model executable. The provided solution raises NotImplementedError.
